final_message:
I wrote the restrictive covenant memo for the Manheim matter (about 10,700 words, 24 tables). It passes `validate.py` and opens cleanly when parsed back. It pulls every covenant, clawback and forfeiture term out of the three documents, with side-by-side comparisons of what the First Amendment changed and where the RSU agreement conflicts with the employment agreement. Its main conclusions are that the Amendment's section numbers don't match the 2021 agreement (so its edits may not have taken effect), its consideration is likely inadequate under North Carolina law, garden leave gives no severance offset when the Company starts the termination, and the RSU clawback reaches only the March 1, 2024 tranche (about $105,700 at $15.10) and only until September 1, 2025.
